notes: Employee profile DB the assistant reads for a persona-gated case. TODAY is pinned to as_of (do NOT use real date.today()); tenure_months is precomputed against it. Each employee links to a worksite via site_id (see sites.json) which supplies state + FMLA worksite headcount; wage/OT/exemption params come from state_rules.json. Personas are engineered so FMLA outcomes each isolate ONE eligibility rule and FLSA outcomes span min-wage compliant/non-compliant, federal-weekly vs CA-daily OT, correctly-exempt, and misclassified-exempt, across CA and TX. `classification` is the employer's LABEL; the misclassification check compares annual_salary against the applicable exempt_salary_threshold_annual.

employees.name: Jane Okafor
employees.leave_reason: Birth and bonding with a new child
employees.notes: Passes all three FMLA tests -> eligible for 12 weeks. Pay above CA minimum. Worked exactly 40h, but a single 10h day triggers 2h of CA daily overtime while federal law would owe zero -- clean state-overlay demo.

employees.name: Marcus Bello
employees.leave_reason: Serious health condition (scheduled surgery and recovery)
employees.notes: Hours and worksite qualify; fails the 12-month tenure floor (isolates FMLA rule 1). TX has no state overlay, so $9/h is legal (>= federal $7.25) and 44h yields 4h of federal weekly overtime only.

employees.name: Lena Vasquez
employees.leave_reason: Care for a parent with a serious health condition
employees.notes: Past 12 months but below the 1,250-hour test (isolates FMLA rule 2). Pay $15/h is below CA's $16.90 minimum -> compliance flag (shortfall $1.90/h). Part-time, no overtime.

employees.name: Tomás Delgado
employees.notes: Qualifies on tenure and hours, but the field project has only 18 within 75mi -> fails the FMLA worksite test (isolates rule 3; employer coverage != eligibility). Exempt salaried at $98k, well above the federal ($35,568) and TX exemption thresholds -> correctly exempt, no overtime owed despite 50h.

employees.name: Aisha Karimi
employees.leave_reason: Extending leave for an ongoing serious health condition
employees.notes: Eligible on all three FMLA tests. Already took 10 of the 12 FMLA weeks and is requesting 6 more. Handbook caps FMLA leave at 8 weeks (below the 12-week legal floor) -> conflict flag + entitlement calc: 2 weeks of FMLA protection remain, not zero. Exempt salaried at $130k (above CA's $70,304 threshold) -> correctly exempt, no OT.

employees.name: Grace Sullivan
employees.notes: FMLA-eligible (18mo, 1,600h, 140 within 75mi). Employer LABELS her exempt, but her $62,400 salary is above the federal exemption threshold ($35,568) yet BELOW California's ($70,304) -> fails the CA salary-basis test -> MISCLASSIFIED -> must be treated as non-exempt and is owed overtime. Regular rate ~$30/h; the 46h week with a 10h day owes ~6h of CA overtime. Headline salary/jurisdiction demo: exempt under federal, misclassified under CA.
